priority: P0 (audit prerequisite, not a site defect)
finding: Network policy blocks the target host and archives; no live-site observation was possible
proposed_change: Allow www.clearconciseconsulting.com (plus web.archive.org, developers.google.com, schema.org, www.salesforceben.com) in the environment network settings, then run evidence/tools/ccc_bounded_crawl.py with URL-INVENTORY.csv URLs as seeds
expected_benefit_mechanism: Unblocks every live check below; converts DISCOVERED_NOT_FETCHED rows to observed rows
implementation_location: Claude Code environment settings
acceptance_test: Crawler writes evidence/crawl/url-inventory-observed.csv with HTTP 200 rows for the seed list; robots.json and sitemap-discovered.json populated

finding: Five URLs on the Squarespace built-in domain are indexed, several with stale positioning ('FAQs 2', 'growing businesses', old nonprofit path)
proposed_change: Verify each returns 301 to the www equivalent (Squarespace should redirect the built-in domain once a primary domain is set). If 200: fix domain settings. Then submit removal/recrawl in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster for the mirror host
expected_benefit_mechanism: Removes duplicate-host retrieval of outdated positioning by search engines and AI retrievers; consolidates signals on one host
confidence: medium (indexed state observed; response codes not)
implementation_location: Squarespace Settings > Domains (primary domain); GSC/Bing removals
acceptance_test: curl -I on each mirror URL returns 301 Location https://www.clearconciseconsulting.com/...; site:clearconciseconsulting.squarespace.com returns 0 results after recrawl window

finding: Non-www URLs indexed with titles identical to /services/salesforce-implementation and /services/salesforce-training (either redirects or duplicate pages)
proposed_change: Verify status and canonical of each. If they are live pages with duplicate titles: give each a distinct title/H1 or 301 to the page that owns the topic. If they already 301: no change, allow index to update
expected_benefit_mechanism: Removes duplicate titles and clarifies which page owns 'administration' and 'ad hoc support' intents
implementation_location: Squarespace page settings (SEO title) or Settings > Advanced > URL Mappings
acceptance_test: Each URL returns 301 to a www page OR returns 200 with a unique title; no two indexed pages share a title

finding: Squarespace commerce cart page is indexed
proposed_change: Set the cart page to noindex (Squarespace: Settings > Advanced > Code Injection cannot target /cart; use Commerce settings / hide from search where available) and confirm it is absent from sitemap.xml; request removal in GSC
expected_benefit_mechanism: Removes a utility URL from brand SERPs and from AI retrieval; small but unambiguous
dependencies: ISS-000 to confirm current meta robots
implementation_location: Squarespace (control to be confirmed: Marketing > SEO or Commerce settings)
acceptance_test: Live /cart HTML contains meta robots noindex or is removed from index within the recrawl window; sitemap.xml excludes /cart

finding: Two different homepage titles are indexed ('Salesforce Consultant NYC | 13x Certified Architect' and 'Salesforce AI Governance & Architecture'); og:description reported stale by owner
proposed_change: Confirm the live title; set one SEO title and matching og:title/og:description that agree with CANONICAL-BUSINESS-FACTS (proposal in PAGE-IMPROVEMENTS.md, PKG-HOME)
expected_benefit_mechanism: One consistent entity statement for search snippets, social previews, and AI retrieval; removes the local-vs-governance ambiguity
confidence: high that inconsistency exists; medium on cause
implementation_location: Squarespace: Home page > Settings > SEO; Settings > Marketing > Social Sharing (og)
acceptance_test: Live <title>, og:title, and og:description match the approved strings; GSC shows one title after recrawl

finding: Question count and scoring described two ways (15 questions / 5 categories vs 30 questions, 1-5 scale, 120 and 60 thresholds) in indexed text attributed to the scorecard
proposed_change: Owner confirms the live instrument. Publish one description (count, scale, thresholds) and label thresholds as CCC professional judgment, not validated prediction. Remove or correct the other text wherever it appears
expected_benefit_mechanism: The scorecard is the secondary business goal; contradictory method statements undermine trust at the exact moment a visitor decides to start
implementation_location: Squarespace page body + SEO description for /scorecard; any article that describes the method
acceptance_test: Live page text and meta description state one count, one scale, one threshold set; search snippet updates after recrawl

finding: The brief's primary offer ('Salesforce AI Data Readiness Assessment') is not observed on the indexed site; site shows 'data quality assessment from $5,000'; owner docs show '$8,000 AI Governance Assessment' and a paid tier named the same as the free scorecard
proposed_change: Owner decides one offer name, scope, price, and landing page. Then align title, H1, FAQ answer, CTA labels, and Service schema (PKG-ASSESS draft). Rename the paid tier so it never shares a name with the free scorecard
expected_benefit_mechanism: A buyer (or an AI answer engine) cannot request an offer it cannot find by name; consistent naming is the mechanism for both discovery and conversion
implementation_location: Squarespace page for the offer; /faqs; Service JSON-LD in page Code Injection
acceptance_test: Site search and GSC show one page titled with the offer name; FAQ price matches; Service schema validates on live URL

finding: Two intake calls described (15-minute call; free 30-minute consultation) without stating the difference
proposed_change: State two distinct paths where either appears: 15-minute scorecard results call; 30-minute scoping consultation. Or collapse to one
expected_benefit_mechanism: Removes a small but real decision-friction point at the CTA
implementation_location: Squarespace CTA blocks and FAQ answers
acceptance_test: Every CTA names its duration and purpose consistently across pages
